source_summary: Vertical ink-wash Chinese landscape with misty mountains, wooded ridges, distant village roofs, foreground pines, rocky slope, and two small scholar figures on a path; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_right_mist_cliff
motifs.description: Large upper-right mountain cliff face with a wooded crest and descending vertical rock striations, partially veiled by pale mist wash.
must_preserve: soft gray ink wash forming the cliff mass
ragged tree silhouette along the ridge crest
vertical dry-brush rock texture and streaks
mist-softened lower edge fading into open space
irregular dark foliage dabs at the top

motifs.name: distant_mist_peak
motifs.description: Small triangular distant peak emerging from haze in the central valley, with faint surrounding mist.
must_preserve: subtle pointed peak silhouette
pale gray wash with low contrast
soft mist edges around the peak
minimal dry-brush mountain texture

motifs.name: left_wooded_bluff
motifs.description: Left middle bluff with sloping gray rock forms and sparse-to-dense ink foliage rising from the ridge.
must_preserve: leaning tree trunks and twig strokes
clustered dark leaf dabs on the ridge top
gray wash slope descending into mist
broken dry-brush rock lines
soft lower fade where the hill dissolves into fog

motifs.name: central_ink_grove_ridge
motifs.description: Dark central grove on a midground ridge, with tall clustered trees and heavy black foliage against mist.
must_preserve: dense black ink foliage masses
thin vertical trunks visible beneath leaf clusters
ragged uneven canopy line
misty gray ridge base
contrast between dark grove and pale background wash

motifs.name: right_bank_village_roofs
motifs.description: Small distant village or pavilion roofs on the right bank, set among faint trees and haze.
must_preserve: simple horizontal roof ridge lines
small angled roof supports and eaves
faint surrounding tree silhouettes
pale atmospheric wash separating structures from background
delicate linear geometry of the huts

motifs.name: foreground_twisted_pines
motifs.description: Large foreground pine composition with twisting trunks and long needle clusters sweeping diagonally across the lower scene.
must_preserve: angular twisted trunk linework
radiating pine needle clusters
dark ink branch contours
drooping and sweeping diagonal boughs
variation between dry thin needles and heavier trunk strokes

motifs.name: lower_right_rocky_slope
motifs.description: Lower-right rocky hillside supporting trees, with layered slanted rock strokes, root-like lines, shrubs, and textured ground.
must_preserve: diagonal dry-brush rock striations
dark root and trunk base contours
scattered shrub foliage dabs
layered slope planes in gray wash
broken ink texture defining the ground

motifs.name: path_scholars_pair
motifs.description: Two small scholar figures on the lower path near the base of the slope, one standing with staff or robe linework and one smaller attendant-like figure nearby.
must_preserve: fine black contour lines of robes
small heads and posture details
standing scholar silhouette
smaller companion figure
minimal path strokes anchoring the figures

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
